Compare Calibration Runs

Select any set of calibration runs to compare their headline validation metrics side by side. Data comes from each run’s summary_metrics_*.json (one per stage, written by that stage’s .qmd at render time — see report/README.md), not from re-reading raw model output, so this page stays fast regardless of how many calibration runs accumulate.

viewof globalCalibRun = {
  const options = calib_runs_ojs;
  if (options.length === 0) {
    return Inputs.select([], {label: "Calibration Run:", disabled: true});
  }
  const stored = window.localStorage.getItem("tdmcalib:selectedRun");
  const initial = options.includes(stored) ? stored : options[options.length - 1];
  const input = Inputs.select(options, {label: "Calibration Run:", value: initial});
  input.classList.add("calib-run-bar");
  input.addEventListener("input", () => {
    window.localStorage.setItem("tdmcalib:selectedRun", input.value);
  });

  // Quarto's own OJS runtime places this cell's returned node into its
  // normal in-page output slot right after this function returns -- moving
  // it into the sidebar synchronously, before that happens, would just get
  // undone a moment later. Deferring to the next tick runs this after that
  // placement, so the move actually sticks.
  setTimeout(() => {
    const sidebar = document.querySelector("#quarto-sidebar");
    const menu = sidebar?.querySelector(".sidebar-menu-container");
    if (!sidebar || !menu) return; // no docked sidebar -- stays inline as a .calib-run-bar
    input.classList.remove("calib-run-bar");
    input.classList.add("calib-run-sidebar");
    sidebar.insertBefore(input, menu);
  }, 0);

  return input;
}
data = transpose(compare_data)
runsAvailable = Array.from(new Set(data.map(d => d.calib_run))).sort()
stagesAvailable = Array.from(new Set(data.map(d => d.stage))).sort()
  • Compare

viewof selectedRuns = Inputs.checkbox(runsAvailable, {
  label: "Calibration Runs:",
  value: runsAvailable
})

viewof selectedStage = Inputs.select(stagesAvailable, {
  label: "Stage:",
  value: stagesAvailable[0]
})
filtered = data.filter(d =>
  selectedRuns.includes(d.calib_run) && d.stage === selectedStage
)

metricsInStage = Array.from(new Set(filtered.map(d => d.metric)))
filtered.length
  ? Plot.plot({
      grid: true,
      height: Math.max(260, metricsInStage.length * 220),
      marginLeft: 70,
      fy: { label: null, domain: metricsInStage },
      x: { label: "Calibration Run" },
      y: { label: "Value" },
      color: { legend: true, label: "Calibration Run" },
      marks: [
        Plot.barY(filtered, {
          x: "calib_run",
          y: "value",
          fy: "metric",
          fill: "calib_run",
          tip: true
        }),
        Plot.ruleY([0])
      ]
    })
  : html`<p><em>No calibration runs have a summary_metrics_*.json for stage "${selectedStage}" yet.</em></p>`
Inputs.table(filtered, {
  columns: ["calib_run", "stage", "metric", "value"],
  header: { calib_run: "Run", stage: "Stage", metric: "Metric", value: "Value" },
  sort: "calib_run",
  rows: 20
})
